name: lemeng.retail_order_line.month.compact.iter
_note: 月度合并子管线（#1905 后续 P1）。由父管线 ctl.foreach 逐月驱动：读该月全部已封版日 → 按 (bizday,branch_num,order_no) 排序 → 写 _MONTH 月文件 + upsert 清单表。
⚠️ 读取用 src.postgres（pg_duckdb）而不是 src.minio：①src.minio 的 glob 只认最后一段 star（mid-path 恒 0 行，两次实测）②code.sql 里的 ${ENV:...} 不展开（实测路径原样带 ${}）③pg_duckdb 自带持久 S3 secret，read_parquet 可直接 glob 跨目录层。
⚠️ glob 的完整路径由父管线拼好经 ${ITER_ITEM_GLOB_PATH} 传入（桶名来自 data.lake_config，ENV 不进 SQL）。
⚠️ 空月 fail-closed：清单说已封版却 0 行 = 日文件缺失，写空月文件会毁数据。
幂等：month 文件 overwrite；清单 upsert；重封版由父管线按 built_at < last_seal 判定重建。

data.label: 读该月日文件（pg_duckdb read_parquet，持久 S3 secret）

properties.sql:
SELECT
r['batch_id']::varchar as batch_id,
r['system_book']::varchar as system_book,
r['bizday']::date as bizday,
r['hour']::int as hour,
r['order_no']::varchar as order_no,
r['order_detail_num']::varchar as order_detail_num,
r['branch_num']::int as branch_num,
r['branch_name']::varchar as branch_name,
r['order_time']::timestamp as order_time,
r['order_operate_time']::timestamp as order_operate_time,
r['state']::varchar as state,
r['order_source']::varchar as order_source,
r['item_num']::varchar as item_num,
r['item_code']::varchar as item_code,
r['sale_money']::numeric(14,2) as sale_money,
r['discount_money']::numeric(14,2) as discount_money,
r['payment_money']::numeric(14,2) as payment_money,
r['quantity']::numeric(14,3) as quantity,
r['order_transaction_type']::varchar as order_transaction_type,
r['order_ref_billno']::varchar as order_ref_billno,
r['order_detail_share_discount']::numeric(14,2) as order_detail_share_discount,
r['order_detail_std_price']::numeric(14,2) as order_detail_std_price,
r['order_detail_price']::numeric(14,2) as order_detail_price,
r['order_detail_online_qty']::numeric(14,3) as order_detail_online_qty,
r['order_total_money']::numeric(14,2) as order_total_money
FROM read_parquet('${ITER_ITEM_GLOB_PATH}') r
ORDER BY bizday, branch_num, order_no

data.label: 空月守卫（0 行=日文件缺失，拒写）

properties.message: month.compact: system_book=${ITER_ITEM_SYSTEM_BOOK} month=${ITER_ITEM_YM} 读到 0 行日文件——清单说该月已封版但 _DAY_DATA 缺日文件，写空月文件会毁数据，拒绝

properties.sql: select '${ITER_ITEM_SYSTEM_BOOK}' as system_book, '${ITER_ITEM_YM}' as ym, count(*)::bigint as rows, sum(sale_money) as sale_money_sum, min(bizday) as min_bizday, max(bizday) as max_bizday, now() as built_at from input
